name: RequestCookies-toString-not-cookie-string
hook: Map.toString() on RequestCookies returns '[object RequestCookies]', not serialized cookies
body: When constructing a Cookie header from a Next.js RequestCookies object, do NOT use cookieStore.toString(). RequestCookies extends Map, and Map.prototype.toString() returns '[object RequestCookies]', not the serialized cookie string. Use Array.from(cookieStore).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; ') instead.
why: This caused the Cookie header sent to /api/users/me to be malformed, potentially breaking session validation for frontend routes while admin worked (which uses a different auth path).
